item.name: Foolscap
entries: Foolscap, the scepter of Momus is a thick rod, white on one end and black on the other. The merest touch from the black end deals {@damage 6d6} force damage to the target. If the Jack of Tears touches another creature with the white end, that creature immediately benefits from {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell heal}, and {@spell regenerate} effects, using the Laughing Man's spellcasting ability. This effect can be used an unlimited number of times per day, but can only affect a single creature once per day.

item.name: The Laughing Mask
entries: The white mask worn by the Jack of Tears provides a +3 bonus to the wearer's Charisma score to a maximum of 30.
